A00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's Strength. This will lead to an increase in damage, better strength items, and a higher chance of getting more strength items in item fields!

A01.recollectionDescription: Increases the base damage of weapons by 2, which can be further increased by other attributes you possess.

A02.recollectionDescription: Your thoughts sink deep into your enemies, ignoring 6 points of armour. Effective with fast weapons that have low base damage.

A04.recollectionDescription: Gives your weapons +1 pierce, letting them damage 2 or more enemies at once.

A05.recollectionDescription: When hit activates a fight response mechanism. Allows you to do 50% more damage with your attacks for a brief moment.

A06.recollectionDescription: Hammer-like mindset, your shots now move bullets out of the way. Also lets your attacks move faster and with more force.

A07.recollectionDescription: Every time you hit a boss gain +6% damage, can increase to a max of +30%. If a projectile misses then the boost resets

A08.recollectionDescription: Intense thoughts do more damage but burn out quicker.

A09.recollectionDescription: Thoughts that take up more space and hit harder.

A10.recollectionDescription: Critical thinking hits where it hurts the most, doing twice as much damage.

A11.recollectionDescription: Field of radiance surrounds your soul. When the soul is hit damage everything nearby and destroy all bullets.

A12.recollectionDescription: The power flowing from your soul overwhelming. The power leaks and does damage to nearby enemies.

A13.recollectionDescription: Overall damage increase to your weapons, balanced strength.

A14.recollectionDescription: Creates an aura around your shots, which does extra damage that can ignore even the strongest armour!

B00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's Vitality. This will lead to an increase in health regen, better vitality items, and a higher chance of getting more vitality items in item fields!

B01.recollectionDescription: Gives all of your hearts an extra 5 health points, allowing you to take more punishment before losing a heart.

B02.recollectionDescription: Blocks off 2 points of damage from every hit done to your soul.

B03.recollectionDescription: Your fulfillment provides you with some extra protection. When losing a heart you gain an extra air-filled heart that acts as a normal heart that loses its max hp every time it is hit.

B04.recollectionDescription: Each of your hearts can take an extra fatal hit, leaving the heart in a broken but repairable state.

B05.recollectionDescription: Projectiles that hit your soul bounce back dealing damage to anything they run into.

B06.recollectionDescription: Converts up to 3 current or future basic lesser hearts into stronger hearts.

B07.recollectionDescription: As you face your demons, occasional words of encouragement will appear in the field. If you collect these words the soul will regain some lost health. If your health is full then instead you gain some essence.

B08.recollectionDescription: Removing your focus on attacking allows you to focus much more on self healing. If the soul is fully healed, then will instead restore essence.

B09.recollectionDescription: Damaging bosses creates speech hearts, collecting these heals the soul.

B10.recollectionDescription: Your negative aura takes health away from nearby bosses and gives it to yourself.

B11.recollectionDescription: Your health bounces back after being hit for 3 seconds.

B12.recollectionDescription: Empathy allows bosses to reveal their heart to you. Damaging the heart damages the bosses and heals the soul.

B14.recollectionDescription: When injured by an attack, hearts inflict punishment upon the source of the damage.

C00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's Essence. This will lead to an increase in essence regen, better essence items, and a higher chance of getting more essence items in item fields!

C01.recollectionDescription: Increases essence regen the longer each battle lasts, up to 40% essence regen

C02.recollectionDescription: Increases your max essence, letting you think of more attacks before needing rest.

C03.recollectionDescription: Allows you to make more complicated thoughts in less time.

C04.recollectionDescription: Very useful for weapons with a low essence cost but a high attack rate.

C05.recollectionDescription: Occasionally release a whip at nearby enemies, sucking up essence when they are hit. Ignores boss armour.

C06.recollectionDescription: Occasionally destroy nearby bullets, which gives you some additional essence.

C07.recollectionDescription: You pretend to reload your weapon between shots. Very good when low on essence.

C08.recollectionDescription: Once per field, you can continue to use your attacks for a bit after running out of essence.

C09.recollectionDescription: Getting hit sends a jolt throughout your ethereal form, allowing you to regain some essence. Extra essence can go above your max

C10.recollectionDescription: Gain extra essence regen and firerate the lower your current heart health is. An additional regen effect is added when on your last heart.

C11.recollectionDescription: When over 50% essence the soul leaks more essence into each shot. These shots do more damage but cost much more. Excess essence can be recollected if quick enough.

C12.recollectionDescription: When out of essence you can continue to attack, but at the cost of some of your life.

C13.recollectionDescription: Extra pool of essence useful for using more complicated weapon ideas.

C14.recollectionDescription: Attacks that cost more than 20 Essence have their essence cost reduced by 50% past that.

D00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's Dexterity. This will lead to an increase in movement speed, better dexterity items, and a higher chance of getting more dexterity items in item fields!

D01.recollectionDescription: Make your soul move through the dreamscape much faster.

D02.recollectionDescription: Quick thinking lets you think of things to attack with faster.

D03.recollectionDescription: By throwing your ideas out there they move 40% faster

D04.recollectionDescription: Decrease the base recharge time of weapons by 2, works well for things that are already quick to think of.

D05.recollectionDescription: Temporarily boosts your speed by a massive amount when hit. During this time you are also invincible. Also gain a longer lasting firerate boost.

D06.recollectionDescription: Once your ideas get out there, they just keep gaining momentum. Projectiles move faster and also will now do more damage based on how fast they are

D07.recollectionDescription: Being mindful lets you shoot faster depending on how much essence you have.

D08.recollectionDescription: Dump your thoughts onto your enemies. This technique is potent, but inefficient.

D09.recollectionDescription: Increased brainstorming capabilities lets you sometimes shoot more shots at a time.

D10.recollectionDescription: Shoot twice as many shots, but each shot only has 65% of its original power.

D11.recollectionDescription: Projectiles have increased initial speed, if they hit an enemy with this increased speed they can do up to 4 additional points of damage

D12.recollectionDescription: Teleporting causes a gust of wind, capable of blowing away bullets.

D13.recollectionDescription: Increased soul speed in multiple aspects.

D14.recollectionDescription: Fast and powerful soul movement causes pressure, which blows back bullets and does damage to enemies.

E00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's Perception. This will lead to a decrease in teleport cooldown, decrease in teleport and weapon cost, better perception items, and a higher chance of getting more perception items in item fields!

E01.recollectionDescription: Process your dreams better, all weapons take 20% less essence to think of.

E02.recollectionDescription: Phase through reality in a less costly matter.

E03.recollectionDescription: Spread out ideas will come together and become focused.

E05.recollectionDescription: More durable thoughts, lets them last longer.

E06.recollectionDescription: Projectiles now home in on nearby foes, increases the homing range of weapons with inherent homing.

E07.recollectionDescription: Projectiles can loop back around to the other side of the field when going past the border.

E08.recollectionDescription: Using advanced perception you are able to reduce the size and influence of enemy bullets sometimes.

E09.recollectionDescription: Teleporting affects the flow of nearby time, causing things to slow down for a bit.

E10.recollectionDescription: When shooting sometimes you stop all bullets in mid air with a powerful aura.

E11.recollectionDescription: Your corporeal form lags behind when teleporting. This allows you to avoid damage for a brief moment. Bosses also don't target the soul for a longer time.

E12.recollectionDescription: Increases your understanding of concepts such as teleporting and thought based weaponry.

E13.recollectionDescription: Good spatial awareness lets you recharge your teleport and essence much faster when near bullets.

E14.recollectionDescription: Teleporting generates a duplicate soul that lingers and shoots for a bit.

F00.recollectionDescription: Increases your soul's State. This will lead to an increase in the charge rate of your state bar, allowing you to transform more often and stay transformed longer. It also comes with a higher chance of getting more state items in item fields!

F01.recollectionDescription: Discover your true self sooner. Recharge state from all sources 30% faster.

F02.recollectionDescription: Enter a flow state allowing you to perform more efficiently. Lose your state charge while transformed slower.

F03.recollectionDescription: The soul's higher state is so powerful that it can't contain its power. Deal massive damage to everything on the screen and push bullets way back when transforming.

F04.recollectionDescription: Grow into your best self. Increases all boosts from your state by 20%.

F05.recollectionDescription: Keep dreaming when in your base form. Gives the soul extra powers in base equivalent to 10% of its state's power.

F06.recollectionDescription: Use spite to get ahead and become stronger. Your state bar charges up proportional to damage take, with bonus state being granted when losing a heart.

F07.recollectionDescription: Any time a boss fight lasts more than 8 seconds you gain chance to instantly gain max state and transform.

F08.recollectionDescription: Every time you transform the soul gains permanent stat boosts

F09.recollectionExtraStats: -40% State Teleport Cost +25% Teleport Effect Power
F09.recollectionDescription: Massive self control allows you to teleport more efficiently and dish out more devestation.

F10.recollectionDescription: Push yourself past your limits. Gain a massively stronger state at the risk of your soul.

G01.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds splash damage to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G02.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds a chance for dealing triple damage to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G03.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds splitting to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G04.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds knockback to it and then shoots it with 10% more power!

G05.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds the chance for duplicating the projectile to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G06.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds freezing to it and then shoots it with high speed.

H01.recollectionDescription: A regular heart made up of some life force, heart dies when its health reaches 0.

H02.recollectionDescription: This heart can regenerate its life force three times as fast as normal!

H03.recollectionDescription: Can survive an extra 2 lethal hits, leaving the heart in a broken but repairable state.

H04.recollectionDescription: Larger than normal, letting this heart take more punishment.

H05.recollectionDescription: Regens Heart much faster when soul is full on essence. Regens essence much faster when heart is full.

H06.recollectionDescription: This heart comes back next room after it dies!

H07.recollectionDescription: Has much more health than normal, but slowly loses it over time. Also gains some health after every boss fight.

H08.recollectionDescription: Shoots imaginary spikes in all directions when hit!

H09.recollectionDescription: Shoots Daggers when hit that make bosses bleed!

H10.recollectionDescription: Shoots Homing Magic Bolts at bosses when hit.

H11.recollectionDescription: Sends a bunch of rockets down from above when hit.

H12.recollectionDescription: Sends in Lightning Bolts from the sky when hit.

H13.recollectionDescription: Increases soul attack rate and movement speed when low on HP. Makes the soul slither.

H14.recollectionDescription: Regains health for all hearts whenever defeating a boss phase or killing an enemy. Soul has the spirit of an wild beast.

H15.recollectionDescription: Gives the soul a 50% chance of shooting back enemy projectiles and negating damage.

H16.recollectionDescription: When damaged, has a large chance of redirecting the damage to another heart slot.

H17.recollectionDescription: While active, gives the soul a slippery bubble trail.

J01.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you strength and more health!

J02.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you vitality and more health!

J03.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you essence and more health!

J04.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you dexterity and more health!

J05.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you perception and more health!

J06.recollectionDescription: Memory of some food you ate, gives you state and more health!

J07.recollectionDescription: Boost the power of your ally souls by allowing them to shoot faster.

J08.recollectionDescription: Boost the power of your ally figments by allowing them to hit harder, and get hit more.

K03.recollectionDescription: Lifting heavy objects makes you stronger over time!

K04.recollectionDescription: Taking your vitamins makes you healthier over time!

K05.recollectionDescription: Essential items give you more essence over time!

K06.recollectionDescription: These dream-like kicks give you more speed over time!

K07.recollectionDescription: Wearing glasses give you more perception over time!

K08.recollectionDescription: Having someone to look up to gives you more state over time!

L01.recollectionDescription: A boost of mental ammunition, gives you a bigger and higher quality stockpile of imaginary weapons. Each weapon now has an extra bit of initial essence that also has a shorter delay.

L02.recollectionDescription: A bag that lets you hold an extra weapon!

L03.recollectionDescription: Provides an extra level of improvement to your currently held weapon. Upgraded weapons shoot 16% faster and consume 16% less essence per level.

L04.recollectionDescription: When life hands you lemons. Losing a heart will give you a permanent +2 increase to a random basic stat.

L05.recollectionDescription: Potential for anything, brings you closer to any state transformation.

M01.recollectionDescription: This soul seems a bit lost, luckily it's on your side. Shoots at bosses and loosely follows your soul. More souls wander into your party the longer the fight goes on.

M02.recollectionDescription: Unlike souls, figments are corporeal. Bosses will target and shoot them, however the figments can die if they are hit too much. Luckily they always come back!

M03.recollectionDescription: Follows bosses and shoots pretty quick for a soul.

M04.recollectionDescription: Comedic punching bag, bosses will target this figment instead of the soul.

M05.recollectionDescription: Shoots fire essence at bosses, if your projectiles go through this soul they will also be set on fire for extra damage!

M06.recollectionDescription: Shoots powerful imaginary explosives at the enemies.

M07.recollectionDescription: Shoots gunpowder, if your projectiles pass through this soul they will gain explosiveness!

M08.recollectionDescription: Produces healthy thinking that heals you if you pick it up!

M09.recollectionDescription: Shoots spike essence at the enemies, Increases the pierce of your projectiles by 1 and shot power by 2.5 if they pass through the soul.

M10.recollectionDescription: When hit will retaliate with a barrage of green essence!

M11.recollectionDescription: Chases down bosses, doing big damage to them.

M12.recollectionDescription: When colliding with a boss will send a bunch of bullets from outside the dreamscape towards itself. Bullets can hurt bosses and your soul!

M14.recollectionDescription: Rushes to bosses, explodes when it dies doing big damage!

M15.recollectionDescription: Shoots poisonous essence, doing damage over time. If your projectiles pass through they also gain poison damage!

M16.recollectionDescription: Increases productivity. Produces essence and blocks enemy bullets.

M17.recollectionDescription: A Soul cursed to inflict sharp damage and make enemies bleed! Will make any projectiles passing through also inflict bleed.

M18.recollectionDescription: Sucks up any nearby bullets into the endless void that is its mouth. Imaginative Appetite.

M19.recollectionDescription: Powerful wizard soul that can home in on enemies. Projectiles passing through gain homing and magic.

M20.recollectionDescription: Produces positive thinking that gives you various stat boosts if you pick it up!

M21.recollectionDescription: Electrical Soul that shoots chain shots. Projectiles passing through gain chain and energy.

M22.recollectionDescription: Figment with self loathing. Shooting this figment with your own weapondry will damage it and cause it to shoot powerful projectiles to harm your enemies.

M23.recollectionDescription: Ally orbits soul and shoots barriers to block out enemy bullets.

M24.recollectionDescription: Orbits the soul, redirecting projectiles until the dream fades away.

M25.recollectionDescription: Scares bosses and boss bullets, causing bosses to take extra damage from all sources.

N01.recollectionDescription: Creative inspiration results in having a 50% chance of getting an extra item in all non-shop item fields

N02.recollectionDescription: Allows you to swap all the items in a field to different items for a price.

N03.recollectionDescription: Quickly suck up all the knowledge/items a field has to offer. One time usage, takes up a weapon slot.

N04.recollectionDescription: Lightbulb that orbits the soul, produces extra recalls if lit at the end of boss fights.

OA01.recollectionDescription: 50% chance to have an extra item in all future item fields. Also increases the amount of recalls granted by defeating bosses by 1.

OA02.recollectionDescription: You can now occasionally turn things into your favor. Converts nearby bullets into wisps that seek out the enemy and deal damage.

OA03.recollectionDescription: Instead of taking items from the current field, you now gain the option to pick 2 random items that can be anything.

OA04.recollectionDescription: Your Shots/Ideas gradually become bigger and more powerful.

OA05.recollectionDescription: The possibilities are endless! Sometimes grants the soul the ability to pick which item pool to pick items from.

OA06.recollectionDescription: The soul gains a very low chance to create an immensely powerful shot. This shot has a powerful aura which damages enemies and erases bullets.

OB01.recollectionDescription: Feeling full of bliss, gain a boost to health and essence regen

OB02.recollectionDescription: Shots take 40% less essence and 30% less time to use. However these carefree thoughts tend to wander in random directions.

OB03.recollectionDescription: While in the happy place gain a big boost to health, essence, and shot rethink speed.

OB04.recollectionDescription: Bullets that get near the soul move 30% slower. No need to stress!

OB05.recollectionDescription: The soul doesn't register that it has taken damage. All damage is now recieved over a period of time.

OB06.recollectionDescription: Shots will now burst in 4 directions when near bosses.

OC01.recollectionDescription: Feeling assured lets you think faster and take slightly less damage. Also increases Shot Speed and decreases Shot Lifespan.

OC02.recollectionDescription: Your sense of security manifests itself in the form of a more secure final heart.

OC03.recollectionDescription: Being stubborn turns your firing pattern into bursts of rapid shooting. All weapons are now 4x barrages that stick to their initial firing angle. Barrages use up 3x essence and 3x reload time.

OC04.recollectionDescription: Deal 25% more damage to enemies, however upon getting hit in a boss fight you will recieve 50% more damage until the end of that field.

OC05.recollectionDescription: All shots fired will follow a direct line toward your cursor.

OC06.recollectionDescription: Focus on two things at once. Shots split in 2 when near bosses in widely different directions.

P01.recollectionDescription: Increases amount of essence you enter a field with, does not actually increase your max essence. Forward thinking allows you to plan ahead and have some idea of what it is you are doing!

P02.recollectionDescription: Increase all base stats by 2, +10 hope that swaps to despair when losing a heart and back.

P03.recollectionDescription: When hit unleash a vindictive soul spirit, does damage and life steal. Stronger based on loathing stat

P04.recollectionDescription: Being careful causes the soul to regenerate health faster when in potential danger.

P05.recollectionDescription: Increases the max stats of charged weapons by 40%.

P06.recollectionDescription: All shots from the soul can be toxic, doing poison damage over time.

P07.recollectionDescription: Occasionally your shots have flames applied to them. These shots do more damage, and can pierce through enemies.

P08.recollectionDescription: Constantly create shots that passively float around for a while.

Q01.recollectionDescription: Occasionally shoot free extra shots that automatically aim at the nearest enemy. Extra damage is a no brainer.

Q02.recollectionDescription: When your thoughts expire from running out of their lifespan, they have a chance to get shot again from the soul.

Q03.recollectionDescription: Shot Projectiles spawn away from soul and then travel back to the soul.

Q04.recollectionDescription: The soul now constantly shoots banana peels on to the field. These redirect any bullets that come in contact with them. They also can make the soul slip.

S01.recollectionDescription: Receiving damage causes the soul to shoot piercing shots in all directions, stronger based on paranoia stat.

S02.recollectionDescription: Receiving damage causes the soul to get backup from a powerful ally soul

S03.recollectionDescription: Receiving damage causes the soul to get emotional support from a powerful ally figment

T01.recollectionDescription: Losing hearts give you a coping heart replacement. This heart steadily loses its max hp, but can shoot extra projectiles at the enemy.

T02.recollectionDescription: Go back to where you're comfortable. Getting hit spawns random healing fields in the field for a bit.

T03.recollectionDescription: When hit you shoot bubbles everywhere. Washes your headspace.

U01.recollectionDescription: All soul projectiles bounce off walls now. Can't get these ideas out of my head.

U02.recollectionDescription: Gives the soul a big boost if a room lasts more than 10 seconds. Sudden burst of energy out of nowhere.

U03.recollectionDescription: By keeping up a train of thought, slowly gain up to +100% firerate and -50% essence cost with a weapon as long as you do not switch weapons, get hit, stop firing, or change shooting angle.

U04.recollectionDescription: All your minions will now circle the soul instead of their typical movement pattern. In addition to this they also all shoot 10% faster.

U05.recollectionDescription: Connecting your ideas allows them to hit multiple targets in a single shot.

U06.recollectionDescription: Completely unload your thoughts, massively increasing firerate but lowering shot power, accuracy, and essence cost.

U07.recollectionDescription: Being close to enemies and enemy bullets greatly increases your firerate and essence gain.

U08.recollectionDescription: Every projectile at any moment could instantly explode into a fart. These farts do splash damage and inflict powerful poison on enemies.

U09.recollectionDescription: Occasionally create freezing shots, which can slow down bosses or freeze bullets.

V01.recollectionExtraStats: +1 to all Basic Stats and positive Spiritual Stats
V01.recollectionDescription: The feeling of wonder boosts your overall power.

V02.recollectionDescription: Gives you the chance to see amazing bonuses after defeating boss fields.

V03.recollectionExtraStats: +4 Random Basic Positive Negative Stat per Floor
V03.recollectionDescription: A mix of preconceived notions affect your attributes in random ways permanently every floor. Applies retroactively as well.

V04.recollectionDescription: Creates a random dark area on the field, this area does damage to everything it touches. Grows more powerful with a higher despair stat.

V05.recollectionDescription: Self Awareness allows the soul to automatically teleport away to a nearby location whenever they would have taken damage.

V06.recollectionDescription: Place an excess of essence into these shots. Occasionally shoot over exerted shots that drain twice as much essence but dish out more damage.

V07.recollectionDescription: Slowly fill up a massive mega shot that does damage to everything on the screen.

V08.recollectionDescription: Producing shots uses up much less essence. Shots will wander around after a set distance in random directions.

W01.recollectionDescription: Deal damage to everything in between your origin and destination when teleporting.

W02.recollectionDescription: Shoot out excess teleporting energy in the form of projectiles. Projectiles aim toward the nearest enemy/boss.

W03.recollectionDescription: A love of bending space allows you to heal yourself when teleporting.

W04.recollectionDescription: Plants a bomb in the inital location during soul teleports.

W05.recollectionDescription: Clears every bullet on screen when teleporting for the first time in each boss battle.

XA01.recollectionDescription: An overall increase in loathing results in 10% more damage being dealt to bosses, but 20% more damage being dealt to the soul. Also lowers shot accuracy.

XA02.recollectionDescription: Boss shots occasionally are overloaded with hatred, causing them to deal double damage and move faster. This can also happen to soul shots at a lower rate.

XA03.recollectionDescription: Getting hit increases your temper. If a temper tantrum is activated you will rapidly lose health for the rest of the fight, while also dealing extra damage to enemies.

XA04.recollectionDescription: Getting hit has a 1/8 chance to convert the soul's rightmost heart into a seething heart. These hearts lose some of their max HP every room, but let the soul light enemies on fire.

XA05.recollectionDescription: Hitting bosses creates loathing speech bubbles which deal extra damage to bosses when collecting. Bosses also shoot out a bunch of bullets due to being provoked.

XA06.recollectionDescription: Hitting bosses with shots causes them to burst into shots which deal additional damage to both bosses and souls.

XB01.recollectionDescription: Being paranoid lowers everyone's aim. It also increases the attack rate of everyone while speeding up boss bullets.

XB02.recollectionDescription: Soul shots can sometimes shake and explode prior to hitting bosses from nervousness. These shots explode into 5 shots that go in random directions.

XB03.recollectionDescription: A panic inducing realization follows behind the soul at a steady pace. This figment shoots bullets that can damage enemies and the soul at a near constant rate.

XB04.recollectionDescription: Causes soul shots and boss bullets to jitter and change directions.

XB05.recollectionDescription: Bosses sometimes shoot extra bullets at the soul. The soul also can sometimes shoot more.

XB06.recollectionDescription: Constant crowd of spirits that wander across the stage. Some of which will attack the soul when near.

XC01.recollectionDescription: The world is full of despair. Increases the difficulty of bosses encountered, while also increasing the amount of damage they deal.

XC02.recollectionDescription: That seeking death feeling. The soul now sucks up nearby bullets, occasionally shoots blackhole shots that also suck up nearby bullets and deal aura damage.

XC03.recollectionDescription: Chains the soul to a minion. Heavily restricting soul movement speed past a certain range. The chain itself can be used to deal extra damage to enemies.

XC04.recollectionDescription: Every time the soul takes damage, all future damage is increased by 2%. Also has a slight boost to the damage the soul deals to bosses.

XC05.recollectionDescription: Every time the soul takes damage, pained spirits will closely follow the soul. These spirits eventually explode dealing extra damage to the soul.

XC06.recollectionDescription: Shots are incapable of directly going at bosses. Instead they trail behind the soul in a conga line. Shots cost 33% less essence and shoot out 15% faster.
